hints.title: Enumerate Subsets
hints.text: The total number of cities n is at most 15, allowing subset enumeration via bitmask.

hints.title: Verify Tree Connectivity
hints.text: A chosen subset of vertices forms a connected subtree if and only if induced edges equal vertices minus one.

hints.title: Compute Subtree Diameter
hints.text: For each valid connected subtree, find the maximum distance among its vertices using precomputed all-pairs distances.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Graph exploration without bitmask representation becomes difficult to enumerate subtrees uniquely.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Precomputing all-pairs shortest paths via Floyd-Warshall takes O(n^3), followed by O(2^n * n^2) mask validation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize n <= 15 constraint and use edge count equality for subtree connectedness.
